"""Private binding-only CPU diagnostics; keep all configurations and misses."""
import cProfile
import hashlib
import inspect
import json
import pstats
import sqlite3
import subprocess
import sys
import time
from pathlib import Path

source = '/tmp/commontrace-staged-snapshot-worktree'
sys.path.insert(0, source)
from commontrace import fact_store as fs, hierarchical as h
from benchmarks.next_generation_storage import items

assert not subprocess.check_output(['git', 'status', '--porcelain'], cwd=source)
root = Path('/tmp/commontrace-p0-million-tuning-root').read_text().strip()
counter = Path('/tmp/commontrace-p0-million-tuning-next-index')
start = int(counter.read_text())
original_content, original_dump = h._content, fs._dump
encoder = json.JSONEncoder(sort_keys=True, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(',', ':'))
tracked = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'ls-files', '-z'], cwd=source, text=True).split('\0')
hashes = {name: hashlib.sha256((Path(source) / name).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
          for name in tracked if name and (Path(source) / name).is_file()}
result = {'scope': __doc__, 'source_root': source,
          'source_commit': subprocess.check_output(['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'], cwd=source, text=True).strip(),
          'source_files_sha256': hashes, 'python': sys.version, 'rounds': [],
          'limitations': ['Growing private million-copy and concurrent frozen full regression; no causal throughput or release gate claim.',
                          'Only _content binding and _dump binding change; the original production functions remain frozen.'],
          'started_at_unix': time.time()}


def advance(n):
    global start
    start += n
    counter.write_text(str(start))


def verify(admitted):
    assert len(admitted) == 1000 and all(action == 'ADD' for _, action in admitted)
    with fs.transaction(root) as facts:
        assert facts.connection.execute("SELECT value FROM meta WHERE key='near_postings'").fetchone() == ('global-v2',)
        assert facts.connection.execute("SELECT 1 FROM lexicon WHERE kind>='near:' AND kind<'near;' LIMIT 1").fetchone() is None
        index = fs.StatementIndex(facts)
        for fact, _ in admitted:
            expected = h._content_uncached(h._signature(fact.statement)[0])
            actual = frozenset(row[0] for row in facts.connection.execute(
                "SELECT l.term FROM lexicon l JOIN postings p ON p.term_id=l.id JOIN facts f ON f.rowid=p.fact_row "
                "WHERE f.id=? AND l.kind='near-v2'", (fact.id,)))
            assert actual == expected
            assert index.near(fact.statement, []).id == fact.id


try:
    for label in ['baseline', 'content_uncached', 'encoder', 'combined', 'combined', 'encoder', 'content_uncached', 'baseline']:
        h._content = h._content_uncached if label in ('content_uncached', 'combined') else original_content
        fs._dump = encoder.encode if label in ('encoder', 'combined') else original_dump
        warm = h.add_facts(root, items(start, 1000))
        assert len(warm) == 1000 and all(action == 'ADD' for _, action in warm)
        advance(1000)
        batch = items(start, 1000)
        cpu = time.process_time()
        wall = time.perf_counter()
        admitted = h.add_facts(root, batch)
        elapsed = time.perf_counter() - wall
        cpu_elapsed = time.process_time() - cpu
        advance(1000)
        verify(admitted)
        row = {'configuration': label, 'batch_size': 1000, 'elapsed_seconds': elapsed,
               'process_cpu_seconds': cpu_elapsed, 'facts_per_second': 1000 / elapsed,
               'canonical_near_sets_and_reader_checked': len(admitted)}
        result['rounds'].append(row)
        print(json.dumps(row), flush=True)
        Path('/tmp/commontrace-write-cpu-next.json').write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2) + '\n')
    profile = cProfile.Profile()
    h._content = h._content_uncached
    fs._dump = encoder.encode
    profile.enable()
    try:
        admitted = h.add_facts(root, items(start, 1000))
    finally:
        profile.disable()
    advance(1000)
    verify(admitted)
    with open('/tmp/commontrace-write-cpu-next.profile.log', 'w') as stream:
        pstats.Stats(profile, stream=stream).strip_dirs().sort_stats('cumulative').print_stats(45)
finally:
    h._content, fs._dump = original_content, original_dump
    fs.close_connections(root)
result['imported_commontrace_files'] = {name: module.__file__ for name, module in sys.modules.items()
                                        if name.startswith('commontrace') and getattr(module, '__file__', None)}
assert all(path.startswith(source + '/') for path in result['imported_commontrace_files'].values())
assert all(hashlib.sha256((Path(source) / name).read_bytes()).hexdigest() == expected for name, expected in hashes.items())
result['prototype_source'] = Path(__file__).read_text()
result['finished_at_unix'] = time.time()
Path('/tmp/commontrace-write-cpu-next.json').write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2) + '\n')
